content.text:
Perfect! Now I have enough information to provide a comprehensive report. Let me compile everything:

---

## COMPREHENSIVE CROBOT PROJECT EXPLORATION

I've conducted a thorough exploration of the CROBOT project. Here's everything you need to understand the current visual state and architecture:

### 1. ALL PAGES IN `src/pages/` (16 pages total)

| Page | Purpose | Visual Approach |
|------|---------|-----------------|
| **Dashboard.tsx** | Main landing for authenticated users - shows stats, recent scans, quick wins, and trend charts | KPI cards (4-column grid), data tables, Recharts area/bar charts, card-based layouts |
| **Scan.tsx** | URL submission & analysis flow with real-time progress | Form-based input, progress timeline, browser frame mockup, Recharts progress bar, loading animations |
| **AuditReport.tsx** | Detailed findings report with pillar scores, findings, and annotations | Score rings (SVG-based), pillar progress bars with benchmarks, finding cards with expandable content |
| **Reports.tsx** | List of all completed scans | Table-based view with filters/sorting |
| **Integrations.tsx** | Third-party integrations management | Card-based settings interface |
| **Settings.tsx** | User account & billing settings | Form-based settings panels with toggles/inputs |
| **Pricing.tsx** | Plan selection page | Pricing cards with feature comparison |
| **Landing.tsx** | Public homepage | Marketing hero section, feature showcase |
| **Login.tsx** | Authentication form | Simple form layout |
| **Signup.tsx** | User registration | Form-based signup flow |
| **ForgotPassword.tsx** | Password reset request | Email form |
| **ResetPassword.tsx** | Password reset completion | Token validation form |
| **AuthCallback.tsx** | OAuth redirect handler | Minimal redirect page |
| **Privacy.tsx** | Privacy policy | Long-form text content |
| **Terms.tsx** | Terms of service | Long-form text content |
| **NotFound.tsx** | 404 page | Error state |

---

### 2. MAIN LAYOUT COMPONENTS

**`AppLayout.tsx`** (Primary authenticated layout)
- Uses `SidebarProvider` from shadcn/ui
- Structure: `<Sidebar> | <TopBar + <main>>`
- Responsive: Sidebar collapsible on mobile
- Main content: max-width 1140px, padding 4-8px (responsive)
- Fixed height layout with `h-screen flex`

**`AppSidebar.tsx`** (Dark navigation sidebar)
- **Colors**: Dark blue background (`--sidebar-background: 222 47% 11.2%`)
- **Navigation items**:
  - Dashboard (LayoutDashboard icon)
  - New Scan (ScanLine icon)
  - My Reports (FileText icon)
  - AI Agents (Bot icon - feature flagged)
  - Integrations (Puzzle icon - feature flagged)
  - Settings (Settings icon)
- **Footer**: Scan usage progress bar, plan badge, upgrade button, admin shortcut
- **Collapsible**: Icon-only collapsed state with tooltips
- Active state: `bg-white/10 text-white` highlight

**`TopBar.tsx`** (Header bar)
- Height: 56px (`--topbar-height`)
- Left: Sidebar toggle + breadcrumb (dynamic page title)
- Right: New Scan button, notifications dropdown, user profile menu
- Backdrop blur with semi-transparent background
- Plan badge dynamically positioned

**`AdminLayout.tsx`** (Admin dashboard layout)
- Similar structure to AppLayout but with admin navigation

---

### 3. VISUAL APPROACH & UI LIBRARY

**UI Framework**: **shadcn/ui** (based on Radix UI primitives)

**Styling**: **Tailwind CSS** with custom theme variables

**Typography**: Inter font family (400, 500, 600 weights)

**Color Palette** (Light mode):
- **Primary**: `#5B5FC7` (Indigo/purple) - used in buttons, accents, charts
- **Background**: Near-white (`0 0% 98.4%`)
- **Foreground**: Dark slate (`220 13% 18%`)
- **Success**: `#22C55E` (Green)
- **Warning**: `#F59E0B` (Amber)
- **Destructive**: `#EF4444` (Red)
- **Muted**: `#E2E8F0` (Light gray)

**Dark Mode Support**: Yes (CSS variable switching)

**Custom Shadows** (Tailwind):
- `shadow-soft`: Ultra-subtle 1px, 2px shadows
- `shadow-soft-md`: Medium soft shadows (hover effects)
- `shadow-soft-lg`: Larger soft shadows
- `shadow-glow-*`: Colored glows (green/amber/red/primary)

**Custom Animations** (Tailwind):
- `fade-in`: 0.35s opacity + translate
- `scale-in`: 0.15s scale from 0.96
- `slide-up`: 0.35s translateY
- `pulse-ring`: Infinite expanding ring (used in progress)
- `shimmer`: Horizontal scan effect

**Border Radius**: 0.5rem default (8px)

---

### 4. SIDEBAR/NAVIGATION COMPONENT

**AppSidebar.tsx** Structure:
```
<Sidebar collapsible="icon">
  <SidebarHeader>Logo + "ConvertScan" (hidden when collapsed)</SidebarHeader>
  <SidebarContent>
    <SidebarMenu> (nav items with icons & labels)</SidebarMenu>
  </SidebarContent>
  <SidebarFooter>
    - Admin shortcut (if user is admin)
    - Scan usage progress indicator
    - Plan badge (free/pro/agency)
    - Upgrade button (if not agency)
  </SidebarFooter>
</Sidebar>
```

**Navigation Features**:
- Feature flag support (`integrations_enabled`, `agent_hub_enabled`)
- Active state styling with white/10 background
- Icon-only tooltips in collapsed mode
- Responsive: Full width on mobile (default), collapsible on desktop

---

### 5. SHARED/REUSABLE COMPONENTS IN `src/components/shared/`

| Component | Purpose | Visual Details |
|-----------|---------|-----------------|
| **ScoreRing.tsx** | Animated SVG score circle (0-100) | Animated stroke-dashoffset, color-coded (green/amber/red), drop-shadow glow |
| **FindingCard.tsx** | Expandable issue card with severity/effort badges | Left border accent, collapsible content, copy button for AI suggestions |
| **KpiCard.tsx** | Metric display with icon, trend, and label | Icon background colors, trend arrow indicators |
| **PillarProgressBar.tsx** | Single pillar score bar | Horizontal bar with color coding |
| **UrlInput.tsx** | Reusable URL input form | Text input + optional page type select + submit button, supports `onSubmit` callback |
| **BrowserFrame.tsx** | Mockup browser window wrapper | Chrome-like frame with address bar, child content display |
| **ScanProgressTimeline.tsx** | Multi-step progress tracker | Vertical timeline with step labels and status |
| **ScanGateWall.tsx** | Gate wall for free users after guest scan | Upsell modal with teaser score |
| **ShareScoreModal.tsx** | Share report on social media | Modal with share links and copy functionality |
| **EmptyState.tsx** | Blank state placeholder | Icon + title + description layout |
| **ChartErrorBoundary.tsx** | Error handler for Recharts | Fallback message if chart fails to render |
| **PremiumLock.tsx** | Premium content lock indicator | Lock icon with "Pro only" badge |
| **SeverityBadge.tsx** | Severity indicator (critical/warning/info/passed) | Color-coded badge |
| **MonitoringSettingsCard.tsx** | Monitoring settings UI | Card with toggles and frequency selectors |
| **PageHeader.tsx** | Page title wrapper | Simple heading container |
| **PageTransition.tsx** | Page fade-in animation wrapper | Applies fade-in animation to page content |

---

### 6. DASHBOARD PAGE (Full Content Summary)

**Dashboard.tsx** (26.7KB) - Core landing page for authenticated users

**Key Sections**:

1. **Header with Greeting**
   - Dynamic greeting based on time of day ("Good morning/afternoon/evening")
   - First name personalization
   - Scan usage indicator with progress bar

2. **KPI Cards Grid** (4-column, responsive)
   - Total Scans (with trend)
   - Avg. CRO Score (with trend, color-coded)
   - Issues Found (count)
   - Quick Wins (count)
